{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Fire Dog''' (丙戌, ''hinoe inu''; onyomi ''heijutsu'') is the 23rd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 23rd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Wood Rooster|ja|乙酉}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Fire Pig|ja|丁亥}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丙'' is Yang Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''戌'' (Dog) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Fire Dog (丙戌)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): bǐngxū
** Cantonese (Jyutping): bing3 seot1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoe-inu
*** On'yomi: heijutsu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): byeongsul (병술)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Bính Tuất

==Months of Yang Fire Dog==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose last digit is 0 or 5 (i.e. when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems}} are either {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)}}), the month of {{ill|September|en|September|qid=Q123|lt=September}} becomes the month of Bingu. However, here the term “month” may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Lichun|en|Lichun|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun}} until the day before {{ill|Jingzhe|af|Jingzhe|cdo|Gĭng-dĭk|fr|Jingzhe|hak|Kiang-chhít|id|Jingzhe|ja|啓蟄|ko|경칩|sv|Jingzhe|vi|Kinh trập|za|Gingcig|zh|惊蛰|zh_classical|驚蟄|zh_min_nan|Keⁿ-ti̍t|zh_yue|驚蟄|qid=Q1306596|lt=Keichitsu}}) as applicable.
